cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.description: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

cards.name: Amaura
cards.description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

cards.name: Aurorus
cards.description: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its body glows a whitish blue.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.description: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

cards.name: Tyrunt
cards.description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

cards.name: Tyrantrum
cards.description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
